My memory lists two Mac actions for the owner, though it doesn't say exactly which "identity checks" they gate:

1. **Grant Screen Recording to "CawCo Agent"** in the Mac's system settings.
2. **Sign in to `gh`** on the Mac.

The run-mac-checks results were 46 escape rows BLOCKED and 5 gh rows SKIP, because gh isn't signed in on the Mac. The gh sign-in clearly accounts for the 5 SKIPs. I didn't record why the 46 rows are blocked, so I can't confirm the Screen Recording grant clears them.

The macOS signing identity itself is stable across nightlies, so nothing is needed there.
